subject: Create build.sh script
description:
## Task: Create the build script for bundling

### Context
Read `scripts/slop-score/prompt.md` for full project context.

### Prerequisites
- Task #10 (analyse.ts CLI) must be complete
- Task #11 (integration tests) must pass

### What to do

#### Create build.sh
Create `scripts/slop-score/build.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Navigate to script directory
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

echo "Building slop-score CLI..."

# Ensure dependencies are installed
if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then
  echo "Installing dependencies..."
  bun install
fi

# Run tests first
echo "Running tests..."
bun test

# Bundle all dependencies into single JS file
echo "Bundling..."
bun build ./src/analyse.ts \
  --outfile analyse.js \
  --target bun \
  --minify

# Show result
SIZE=$(du -h analyse.js | cut -f1)
echo ""
echo "Build complete!"
echo "  Output: analyse.js ($SIZE)"
echo ""
echo "Usage:"
echo "  bun scripts/slop-score/analyse.js input.md"
echo "  bun scripts/slop-score/analyse.js input.md --all"
echo "  bun scripts/slop-score/analyse.js input.md --format markdown"
```

#### Make it executable
```bash
chmod +x scripts/slop-score/build.sh
```

#### Test the build
```bash
cd scripts/slop-score
./build.sh
```

#### Verify the bundled version works
```bash
# From project root
bun scripts/slop-score/analyse.js data/test.txt
```

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] build.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Running build.sh produces analyse.js
- [ ] analyse.js is under 3MB
- [ ] Bundled version produces same output as source version
- [ ] No errors during build process
